These substantive binding regional norms meet the regional-ordinance rule despite their constitutional politico-administrative designation. The 32 departmental assemblies qualify; capital municipal councils do not qualify by analogy.
records.authority_review_limits: This does not equate departmental ordinances with sovereign national statutes or certify any stream. San Andrés retains its special ethnic/territorial framework; only its departmental assembly is covered here.
records.service_register_scope: Historical 652-entry cohort only; authority clearance is not service validation.

records.name: Majelis Rakyat Papua Provinsi Papua
records.decision_basis: The current statute assigns provincial enactment, APBD adoption and general executive/policy supervision to DPRP with the governor. MRP is the separate cultural/Indigenous-rights consent institution, without the general territorial legislative-finance role required for an additional catalogue legislature. Constitutional cultural representation or a parliamentary-style plenary alone does not supply that role.
records.preserved_substantive_power: MRP consideration and consent is legally required in the specified Perdasus process; the institution also has Indigenous-rights representation and scrutiny/reconsideration rights. This is not a finding that it has no legally consequential power.

records.decision_basis: Eligible for the national legislative inventory: constitutional regional-bill initiative and substantive bill deliberation, implementation scrutiny and budget advice establish a national legislative participant. Its lack of final bill assent is preserved, rather than describing it as an equal-power upper chamber.

records.name: Majelis Permusyawaratan Rakyat (MPR)
records.decision_basis: Eligible as the national joint constitutional organ with power to amend/adopt constitutional provisions. It is composed of DPR and DPD members, with presidential constitutional functions; it is not a third ordinary billmaking chamber or another set of independently elected members.
